turns.utterance: Do you see any magazine deformation, cracked pockets, or broken gripper fingers?

turns.utterance: Replace the worn locating pins and verify with a go/no-go gauge after fitting.

turns.utterance: Locating pins replaced and verified with the gauge. All pins now pass the fit check.

turns.utterance: Load a standard toolholder into the spindle and attach the pull gauge to the retention knob. Apply a steady axial pull, record the peak force at drawbar release, and compare it against the minimum drawbar retention force in the machine specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Pull test complete. I recorded the peak force and it's reading below the minimum specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Load a standard toolholder into the spindle and attach the pull gauge to the retention knob. Apply a steady axial pull and record the peak force at drawbar release. turns.utterance: Is the tool retention force within the rated range for all tested pockets?

turns.utterance: No, the retention force is consistently below specification across the pockets I tested.

turns.utterance: Adjust the drawbar clamping pressure or replace the Belleville washers.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Drawbar overhaul complete. I found two springs with visible deformation and replaced the entire stack. Preload has been reset to spec.

turns.utterance: Do the tool changer safety interlocks function correctly?

ground_truth.node_text: Tool changer safety interlocks function correctly?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the arm swing speed within the specified range?

ground_truth.node_text: Arm swing speed within specified range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the arm cycle time matches the target specification. No excessive delay observed.

ground_truth.node_text: Arm swing speed within specified range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Were all 10 tool changes completed without fault or alarm?

ground_truth.node_text: All 10 tool changes completed without fault or alarm?

turns.utterance: No, I had two cycles that generated alarms. One required a retry to complete.

ground_truth.node_text: All 10 tool changes completed without fault or alarm?

turns.utterance: Access the alarm log and filter by tool changer related alarm codes. Record the tool number, pocket number, and alarm description. Check whether the alarm pattern correlates with a specific pocket or tool.

turns.utterance: Reverify the tool changer cycle after fault investigation.

turns.utterance: The problem persists. I'm still getting faults on pocket 7 during the test cycle.

turns.utterance: Procedure complete. Escalate to maintenance engineer for persistent tool changer cycle fault. The station requires specialist attention before returning to production.
